tests.name: M01 invalid State plus valid configuration and reverse have no partial effects
M01 valid State and configuration publish one coherent new generation
M01 failed build after a retained Component input becomes pending preserves its live State
M01 failed dynamic update preserves State, old tree and an in-flight Action connection

covered: Invalid State and invalid structure each leave prior State/definition/projection unchanged.
Valid State/configuration changes publish coherent values.
Late dynamic build failure preserves existing pending-input owner and active Action connection.

tests.name: M02 synchronous and asynchronous Query errors retain committed configuration and State

covered: Both synchronous throws and rejected request promises become Query errors after commit.
Committed configuration/State persist and initial report identifies the Query error without private exception text.

tests.name: M03 only instance A changes while B handle and shared definition remain intact
M03 replacing only instance A preserves B state and the common definition

covered: Replacing only A leaves B instance/State handle and registered common definition unchanged.

tests.name: M04 definition updates affect future injection while existing mounted definitions stay pinned
M04 Query, Variable, Type and Action references stay pinned across updates until explicit replacement

covered: Mutating original database-like input does not affect registered/mounted definitions.
Registry updates do not auto-follow in existing Component, Type, Variable, Query or Action references, including refresh/handlers after View.update.
Future mount and explicit replace inject new definitions.

tests.name: M05 replacement cleans prior owned URL and State while service State and foreign URL survive

covered: Replace creates a new owner lifetime and invalidates old internal State handles.
Only old owned URL keys are cleaned with replace history; service State, foreign keys and fragment survive.
Disposing the View leaves service-owned State usable.

tests.name: M06 State, current configuration and reusable definitions export independently without autosave

covered: All three change targets are supported.
Definition exports retain declaration initial values independently of live State values.
View/resource exports are detached, JSON serializable, and unaffected by editing the returned copies.
Saving is an explicit service function in the fixture.

tests.name: M07 listing does not grant invoke or update rights; denied update starts no State/Query/URL effects
M07 UI events and explicit invocation use the same deny and allow Action policy
M07 denied existing-view replacement preserves State, URL, connections and data execution

covered: List/describe do not grant invocation rights; invalid/disposed owners are rejected.
UI and explicit Action calls share deny/allow policy.
Denied update/replace preserve State/configuration/lifetime/URL and start no data requests.
notes: Service-specific actor/public-target filtering and external agent adapters remain host integrations; this fixture exercises the common core authorization hook.

tests.name: N01 inline static business definitions mount without resolver or Query executor callbacks

covered: Static inline business definitions mount with registered code Component contracts and no resolver/requestExecutor callbacks.

tests.name: N02 referenced definitions resolve recursively in their expected kind and invalid resolution keeps current View
N02 malformed resolved graph never executes data or replaces the current screen
N02 unknown reference without resolver fails clearly; default public native HTTP works without a supplied executor

covered: Missing resolver, wrong returned kind and missing graph child fail clearly and preserve current screen.
Recursive valid resolution uses expected resource kinds.
Invalid preparation starts no data request.
The shipped direct HTTP executor is a supported default; a missing custom requestExecutor is not an error. Actual native HTTP default behavior is covered by runtime-query.test.mjs.

tests.name: slots, event handlers and inline actions use their actual contracts
U01 runtime accepts empty required slots and omitted optional slots as empty content

covered: Required slot absence is rejected; explicit empty array is accepted by actual registry.
Runtime projects explicit empty required slots and omitted declared optional slots as empty content.

tests.name: U02 forwarded slots retain author state and original child ordering

covered: Directly forwarded slot nodes read and react to author State rather than receiver State.

tests.name: U02 forwarded slots retain author state and original child ordering

covered: Multiple slot nodes retain author order and are represented as separate children.

tests.name: U04 invalid event payload calls no Action and preserves idle observation

covered: Invalid typed event payload reports TYPE_MISMATCH, invokes no Action and preserves idle observation.

tests.name: A15/A16 self-removing Action cancels remaining steps and recreates an idle connection

covered: when false removes the connection; returning true creates a new generation and idle observation while owner State remains.

tests.name: U06 repeat reorder preserves key-owned state; remove and re-add creates a fresh lifetime
A20 realized repeated action connection ids are rejected atomically
M01 failed dynamic update preserves State, old tree and an in-flight Action connection

covered: Key reorder preserves State/instance, removed then re-added key creates fresh State lifetime.
Duplicate repeat keys fail atomically without replacing the prior screen.

tests.name: U07 moving a stateful node between Row slots preserves its handle and instance
U07 moving the same local node id into another author Component creates a new lifetime
U07/C07 temporarily missing required input preserves the existing Component State lifetime
U07/C07 temporarily error required input preserves the existing Component State lifetime
U07/C07 reactions reconnect to actual State ports and pause while required input is unavailable
U07 suspended nested owner preserves active Action, local State and Query handle until resume

covered: Moving a node between layout Row slots in the same author owner preserves instance/State identity.
Moving the same local node ID into another author Component creates a fresh State/instance lifetime.
Temporary missing/error required inputs preserve direct Component local State through recovery.
Reactions reconnect to actual changed source/target State ports, detach while suspended and resume on input recovery.
Nested suspended owner scopes, active Action connections, local State and Query handles survive repeated pending refreshes; owned Query work is gated and resumes with new inputs.

tests.name: Component cycles include inline definitions and do not reject shared DAG children
U11 unused direct self and separate registered Component cycles fail before any execution

covered: Unused inline Component back-reference cycles are rejected at registration; valid shared-child DAGs are accepted.
Unused direct self-reference and separate independently registered A→B→A Component cycles are each rejected atomically.

tests.name: UI statically validates when:false, node scopes, root and nested repeat aliases
U06 repeat reorder preserves key-owned state; remove and re-add creates a fresh lifetime
U12 node ids remain unique across two Row containers in one author owner

covered: Same-owner duplicate node IDs are rejected.
Separate Counter instances each accept the same internal render node ID.
Duplicate author node IDs remain invalid across two different layout Rows.

tests.name: U13 nested repeat reads outer and inner aliases and scopes equal keys under each parent

covered: Nested different repeat aliases are simultaneously readable, and equal child keys under separate parents do not conflict.

tests.name: A14 action observations exist before earlier sibling inputs and remain current while running

covered: Earlier sibling inputs read later Action connection idle/running/success state correctly, independent of traversal order.

tests.name: A15/A16 self-removing Action cancels remaining steps and recreates an idle connection

covered: Removed connection cancels its call; recreated same observed ID is idle/new generation and old event target is rejected.

tests.name: A15/A16 self-removing Action cancels remaining steps and recreates an idle connection

covered: SetState removing its own connection preserves the completed State write and prevents subsequent Action step.

tests.name: A20 realized repeated action connection ids are rejected atomically
A20 projecting one author slot twice rejects duplicate realized connections

covered: Repeated and multiply projected connections cannot share one observed ID in the same author owner.

tests.name: A21 same internal action id in separate instances is independent and anonymous running duplicates are ignored

covered: Separate Component owners can use the same internal observed ID and run independently.
Anonymous connection ignores additional invocation while active without sharing other connection state.

tests.name: A22 failed dynamic action input reports preparation error and executes no implementation

covered: Dynamic input type failure executes zero native effects, sets error/running:false/data:null, and identifies /inputs plus port name.

tests.name: U07 suspended nested owner preserves active Action, local State and Query handle until resume

additionalFindings.observed: After an ancestor becomes pending, repeated reconciliation loses the retained nested subtree and cancels nested State/Action lifetime.
additionalFindings.expected: Preserve nested owners, active connection, State and Query handles through suspension; gate new Query work, then resume with the same lifetime.
additionalFindings.resolution: Parent retains an internal nested subtree across repeated suspended refreshes; actual-package management 24/24 now passes.
